latest.title: Warming prehospital whole blood: no coagulopathy difference
latest.finding: Trauma-induced coagulopathy on ED arrival in 21.3% (warmed) vs 27.7% (cold); adjusted OR 1.07 (95% CI 0.45–2.49), with no association with massive transfusion or 24-hour or 30-day survival.
